name: Ciaran Walsh
brief_description: a small boy with bare feet and bright eyes

home.name: The Boatman's Cottage
home.description: A small thatched cottage perched above the waterline, with nets drying on a stone wall and a currach pulled up on the shingle. The smell of turf smoke and fish mingles in the air. It is daylight. The lake stretches away under the weather sky.

source_personality_summary: A curious, adventurous child who is always exploring — the shore, the bog, the fields.
source_knowledge: Knows where every heron nests along the shore of Lough Ree.
Found a strange old coin on the beach that his father says is very old.
Saw a big fish — maybe the Lough Ree monster — surface near Hare Island.
Knows which rocks are safe to climb on and which are slippery.

source_schedule_cues.activity: playing at the crossroads with other children
at Mass with his parents, fidgeting on the bench
at the lough shore with his father, learning about the water
exploring the lough shore, collecting shells and feathers
playing at the bay, skipping stones, watching his father's boat
breakfast, helping his mother with small chores
home for the evening, stories and bed
stories by the fire, then bed
